title: Biogas, Biomethane and Digestate Potential of By-Products from Green Biorefinery Systems
geography: West Cork, Ireland; green-biorefinery co-products from cultivated perennial ryegrass
data_handling: Transcribed numeric and ratio values reported in Table 4. Source footnote marks moisture, total solids, and ammonia as as-received; all other Table 4 values are dry-mass basis. No uncertainty was stated for these values. Blank cells in the source table are omitted, never represented as zero.
limitations: The digestates are from triplicate 1 L batch BMP tests on cultivated perennial ryegrass biorefinery by-products, not roadside grass and not a continuous GreenHub digester.
The article reports BMP tests at 37 °C for 21 days, with a 4:1 inoculum-to-substrate ratio; digestate composition is conditional on that laboratory test and its feedstreams.
Total phosphorus is not dissolved orthophosphate, nutrient availability, or an ion-speciation result; elemental potassium is not K2O fertilizer grade.
The article does not provide a closed digestate mass balance or fertilizer acceptance/contaminant assessment for GreenHub.
No uncertainty statistic is reported in Table 4; do not infer one from the measurement method.
Table 1 explicitly labels oxygen as by difference; Table 4 does not repeat the method. Its oxygen values are retained as source-reported with this ambiguity flagged, not recalculated.
